mechanism: Bumetanide may reduce renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, potentially decreasing cefdinir clearance and increasing antibiotic exposure; cephalosporins can rarely cause nephrotoxicity that may be potentiated by loop diuretics.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) during concurrent therapy; ensure adequate hydration; adjust cefdinir dosing if renal impairment develops.
